newsitem.title: USA: VSI sees trimmed Q1 net loss, higher revs.
newsitem.headline: VSI sees trimmed Q1 net loss, higher revs.

text.p: VSI Enterprises Inc on Monday said it expects to report a first quarter net loss in excess of $1 million, on revenues of about $5.5 million.
The company it reported a loss of $1.7 million in the first quarter 1996 on revenues of $3.0 million.
VSI says it expects to announce complete first quarter 1997 results by April 30, 1997.
VSI attributed its revenue growth to an increase in videoconferencing system sales, as well as strong results from its wholly owned subsidiary Eastern Telecom Inc.
